# Display snippets for docs/http.md

--8<-- [start:simple_request_examples]
get("http://example.com", BODY)

dict_pairs(HEADERS, ['Authorization'-"Bearer TOKEN"]),
get("http://api.example.com/data", HEADERS, BODY)

post("http://example.com/submit", "key=value", RESPONSE)
--8<-- [end:simple_request_examples]

--8<-- [start:general_request_example]
dict_pairs(OPTIONS, [url-"http://example.com", method-"HEAD"]),
request(OPTIONS, STATUS, BODY)
--8<-- [end:general_request_example]

--8<-- [start:json_request_examples]
json_get("http://api.example.com/users/1", USER),
get_strict(USER, name, NAME)   % JSON object keys are atoms: name, not "name"

dict_pairs(ITEM, [name-"Widget", price-9.99]),
json_post("http://api.example.com/items", ITEM, RESPONSE)
--8<-- [end:json_request_examples]

--8<-- [start:url_encode_examples]
encode("hello world", E)   % E = "hello%20world"
decode("hello%20world", S) % S = "hello world"
--8<-- [end:url_encode_examples]

--8<-- [start:url_parse_examples]
parse("https://example.com:8080/path?q=1#frag", PARTS)
% PARTS: scheme "https", host "example.com", port 8080,
%        path "/path", query "q=1", fragment "frag"
% (atom keys, string values)

dict_pairs(PARTS, [scheme-"https", host-"example.com", path-"/api"]),
join(PARTS, URL)
% URL = "https://example.com/api"
--8<-- [end:url_parse_examples]

--8<-- [start:build_query_url]
:- use_module(library(url), [encode/2]).
:- use_module(library(http), [json_get/2]).

search_api(QUERY, RESULTS) :-
    encode(QUERY, SAFE_QUERY),
    append("https://api.example.com/search?q=", SAFE_QUERY, URL),   % strings are lists
    json_get(URL, RESULTS).
--8<-- [end:build_query_url]

--8<-- [start:health_check]
:- use_module(library(http), [request/3]).

health_check(URL) :-
    dict_pairs(OPTIONS, [url-URL, timeout-5]),
    request(OPTIONS, STATUS, _),
    STATUS =:= 200.
--8<-- [end:health_check]
